evidenceNotes: All screenshots and logs are generated by the current PHASE-3-001 verification run; no Phase 2 screenshot is collected.

Normal and mobile screenshots position real hazards deterministically while using the actual gameplay renderer and HUD. Debug screenshots freeze the simulation and hide the pause overlay to expose wire bounds.
Amber is the original outer sphere. Mint boxes for the half meteor, barrel and generator form an additional simultaneous collision condition. Pink is the unchanged player sphere.
Production is requested with ?debug=colliders; tests verify the debugger DOM is absent and its unique geometry marker is absent from the emitted script.
Five debug restarts check GPU counts, object identity and six model downloads; teardown verifies both cached wire geometries are disposed once.
The missing-model test intentionally creates an HTTP 404 and verifies retry recovery. Other browser tests require clean console/network logs.
limitations: Physical phones, Safari/Firefox and sustained performance remain unverified.
Collision proxies approximate surfaces; rounded-box/sphere intersections can retain small conservative errors near seams, with bounded rotation padding below 0.007 world units at 120 Hz.
The approved forgiving ship sphere excludes decorative wings. Audio, visual effects and Yandex SDK are outside PHASE-3-001.
The existing Vite chunk-size advisory remains unchanged; no build-system refactor or threshold adjustment.
